## Index the workflows into Postgres
Asks n8n's own REST API for every workflow, builds a one-paragraph description of each (name, trigger, nodes, sticky notes), turns it into a vector, and upserts it into `workflow_index` with pgvector.

Runs nightly and on demand. Workflow 07 searches this table; 06 is the chat on top.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO workflow_index (id, name, description, trigger, node_count, active, embedding, indexed_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::vector, now())
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, trigger = EXCLUDED.trigger,
  node_count = EXCLUDED.node_count, active = EXCLUDED.active, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, indexed_at = now()
RETURNING id, name;

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all().map(i => i.json);
return [{ json: { indexed: rows.length, workflows: rows.map(r => r.name) } }];
